_about: What an ARRIVING party does to the place it reaches (VAMILY row [raids make traits]). Battle Brothers' two situations are read off their wiki pages (effects, with quotes); WHAT SETS THEM is the one place we differ and it is marked ours: in Battle Brothers a place becomes Raided when YOU fail to protect it or fail the contract, and Well Supplied when you finish an Escort Caravan contract; here the valley has no contract behind its parties, so a crew that reaches a place unopposed sets Raided and a caravan that reaches a place sets Well Supplied, and a party you stopped on the road sets nothing. How long a situation lasts is not on the wiki; the default is one week, RUN TWO's own trait period (settlement_traits.json roll.period_days).

set_by.bb: fail to protect the attached location or fail the contract
set_by.bb_quote: The settlement will get the Raided settlement situation if you fail to protect the attached location or fail the contract.
If you finish this contract, the settlement will become well supplied. If you poorly complete the contract, it won't.

duration_days.why: not on the wiki; RUN TWO's trait period is 7 days (records/target/settlement_traits.json roll.period_days)

stacking.value: a second arrival refreshes the end day; it never doubles the effect

value: the player's own base (the raid chain owns that)
